## Checklist

<!-- Please check all boxes that apply by replacing [ ] with [x] -->

### Before submitting

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CarmJos/quarkdown-for-intellij/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines.
- [ ] I have linked the related issue in the description above.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests that prove my fix/feature works.
- [ ] I have run `./gradlew test` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `./gradlew ktlintCheck` and no formatting issues are found (if applicable).
- [ ] I have verified the plugin builds successfully with `./gradlew buildPlugin`.
- [ ] I have manually tested the changes in a running IDE instance (`./gradlew runIde`).
